subject: maths
question: If tan A = (2)/(5) find the value of (sec ² A)/(operatorname{cosec)² A}.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We know that **tan A = sin A / cos A** and **sec A = 1 / cos A**, **cosec A = 1 / sin A**.

The expression **sec² A / cosec² A** simplifies to **(1 / cos² A) / (1 / sin² A) = sin² A / cos² A = tan² A**.

Given **tan A = 2/5**.

∴ **tan² A = (2/5)² = 4/25**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4/25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51f327a6fce67a6ee2230ebe76b5fc91e034c897f2798d31f18c0c5474ec0302.png] 

**Given:** tan A = 2/5

**Formula Used:** sec² A = 1 + tan² A; cosec² A = 1 + cot² A; cot A = 1/tan A

⇒ Expression = sec² A / cosec² A

⇒ Expression = (1/cos² A) ÷ (1/sin² A)

⇒ Expression = sin² A / cos² A = tan² A

⇒ Value = (2/5)²

⇒ Value = 4/25

**∴ The correct answer is 4/25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

sec θ = 1/cos θ; cosec θ = 1/sin θ; cot θ = 1/tan θ.</p
